'''Wind Bolt''' is an [[Wind spells|air]]-based [[Bolt spells|bolt spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 17 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Wind Bolt's base maximum hit starts at 9 and increases as the player unlocks additional bolt spells, up to 12. Players who have completed the [[Family Crest]] quest can wear [[Chaos gauntlets]] to increase the maximum hit by an additional +3, up to 15 at level 35 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Wind Bolt's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an air-based spell, Wind Bolt's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to air]].
